name: Auto-trigger RLE with Variable Length Codes
definition: A compression method for voxel data that treats the world block as a linear series of voxels. It uses an 'auto-trigger' mechanism to detect runs of identical voxels without a fixed guard bit, combined with variable length codes for both voxel types and run lengths to exploit skewed distributions.
summary: Auto-trigger RLE with Variable Length Codes is a lossless voxel compression method that encodes runs only after a repetition threshold, avoiding overhead on short sequences and adapting to skewed data distributions.
